title: GoOrganicAfrica Chad calculator-readiness review

administrative_geography.note: Province selector only. Lower levels are deliberately excluded. Crosswalk legacy names and boundaries before assigning historical crop records.

agricultural_evidence.observation: 2025 aggregate cereal production estimated at about 3 million tonnes, approximately 10% above the previous five-year average.
agricultural_evidence.use_limit: National aggregate context only; not crop-specific or province-specific yields.

agricultural_evidence.observation: 2026 cereal crop prospects uncertain after irregular rainfall, dry spells and poor vegetation conditions in several provinces.
agricultural_evidence.use_limit: Outlook/risk context, not a final 2026 harvest result.
National cereal aggregate; retain as a cross-source check, not a crop-by-province input.

agricultural_evidence.observation: 73-market monthly price estimates available through 2026-10-01, including maize, millet, sorghum, rice and other food products.
agricultural_evidence.use_limit: Market estimates; not farmgate by default and may include machine-learning estimates. Validate each record's market, date, currency, confidence and interpolation flags.

agricultural_evidence.observation: Documents a historical INSEED-linked crop-statistics archive for 2010-2023 and province-level reporting methodology.
agricultural_evidence.use_limit: Underlying tables remain to be exported and extracted; historical survey coverage and production systems must be checked before comparison.

data_access_route.description: FEWS NET identifies an INSEED-linked online data portal with a crop-statistics archive covering 2010–2023.
data_access_route.status: archive identified; detailed tables not extracted in this batch

outstanding: extract and reconcile World Bank 73-market price observations; do not relabel retail/market estimates as farmgate
export INSEED-linked 2010-2023 crop archive and extract crop/province/season metadata
resolve 70-department OCHA COD-AB versus 115-department administrative-profile discrepancy before lower-level selector work
extract current SIMPA/SIM Livestock producer and market-price records where available

safeguards: No active calculator profile or formula changed.
No prices, yields or input costs invented.
No national aggregate copied into province-level values.
Chad remains research-only and not calculator-ready.
World Bank modelled market estimates are not treated as observed farmgate prices.
Programme targets and project-area outcomes are not converted into national crop yields or generic input budgets.
Province selector retained; lower administrative levels remain blocked pending crosswalk.

evidence_refresh.summary: Refreshed FAO 2026 outlook, World Bank market-price series, provincial geography and active agricultural programme evidence. Research-only; no calculator inputs certified.

observations.comparison: approximately 10 percent above the previous five-year average
observations.limitation: National cereal aggregate only; not crop-specific or province-specific yield.
Irregular onset of rains, dry spells, poor crop establishment in some areas and insecurity-related disruption; not a final harvest estimate.

observations.observation: Local sorghum and millet retail prices stable or increased by up to 15 and 20 percent respectively; local maize trends mixed.
observations.limitation: Trend information only; not absolute farmgate prices.

new_findings.source: World Bank Microdata Library — Monthly food price estimates by product and market
new_findings.limitation: Market-level food-price estimates assembled from public sources and machine-learning estimates for missing observations; price type is not farmgate by default. Inspect currency, market, date, data_coverage, index_confidence_score and spatially_interpolated fields before use.

observations: Confirms 23 province-level administrative units and identifies INSEED-linked crop-statistics archive methodology.
Historical 2010-2023 crop archive is a source lead; underlying crop records still require export and extraction.
Main and winter off-season agricultural seasons are distinguished; major crops include sorghum, millet, berbéré and cotton.
new_findings.limitation: Historical archive and methodology do not establish current province-by-crop yields or farm budgets.

new_findings.source: OCHA / HDX Chad Subnational Administrative Boundaries
observations: COD-AB dataset identifies 23 provinces and 70 departments.
new_findings.limitation: A separate administrative profile reports 115 departments and 420 communes under the 2021 reform. Keep the province selector as the stable level and do not publish lower-level selectors until the boundary crosswalk and dataset versions are reconciled.

observations: Targets 3,000 smallholder farmers, with 60 percent youth and 40 percent women, and expected reach of 50,000 people.
Activities include 20 agroecology field schools, 10 bioinput production units, 60 demonstration plots and five rural business hubs across Mayo-Kebbi Est, Mandoul, Chari Baguirmi and N'Djamena.
new_findings.limitation: Programme scope and beneficiary targets are not measured yields, input prices or enterprise budgets.

observations: Estimated 146,000 beneficiary households; project supports water infrastructure, rural roads, family farming and agropastoral value chains, mainly in Batha, Chari Baguirmi, Guéra, Hadjer-Lamis and Salamat.
new_findings.limitation: Project target is not proof of realized output or farm profitability.

observations: Approximately 35,000 households / 175,000 direct beneficiaries; intervention includes four departments in Guéra and departments of Fitri (Batha) and Dababa (Hadjer-Lamis).
new_findings.limitation: Project design and target-group characteristics are not a substitute for current crop budgets.

observations: More than 2,400 hectares of polders rehabilitated in Chad; solar irrigation reportedly reduced water costs by 90%; Mamdi cultivated land rose from 39 percent to full capacity and annual harvest value from USD 3.5 million to USD 8 million.
new_findings.limitation: Project-area results only; not nationally representative crop yield or standard input-cost assumptions.

observations: Project appraisal and supporting environmental documents identify a pilot 240-hectare rice perimeter at Eré and irrigation / rural infrastructure investment.
new_findings.limitation: Planned project area and appraisal evidence are not observed commercial farm budgets or national yield estimates.

newly_improved: market-price source freshness and market coverage
